title: Setu Gateway Plugin Manifest
description: One entry in marketplace/registry.json - describes a community-published plugin, mirroring the shape of the built-in plugins under plugins/ (see packages/plugin_sdk).

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in marketplace listings.

version.description: Semantic version of this plugin release.

repository.description: Public source repository URL - required for the security review in DESIGN.md.

entryPoint.description: Python import path to the plugin class, e.g. 'my_plugin.provider.MyProviderPlugin', matching packages/plugin_sdk.BasePlugin's contract.

setuVersion.description: Semver range of compatible Setu Gateway versions, e.g. '>=0.2.0'.

certification.description: Filled in by the registry, not the plugin author - the output of `setu certify` (apps/gateway/certification), only meaningful for category=providers.
